instruction: Pull over beside the dark car closest to us on the right.
paraphrases: Stop next to the nearby dark car on the right.|Park beside the prominent right-hand dark car.

instruction: Pass the white car ahead, then stop near the black SUV on the right.
paraphrases: Go past the white car in front and pull over by the black SUV on the right.|After the white car ahead, stop beside the right-hand black SUV.

instruction: Pass the partially visible truck at the right edge, then stop near the white sedan on the left.
paraphrases: Go past the cut-off truck on the right and stop by the white sedan on the left.|After the partly visible right-edge truck, pull over near the white sedan.

instruction: Stop beside the white sedan on the left, not the large bus on the right.
paraphrases: Take the white sedan on the left rather than the large bus on the right.|Pull over by the left-hand white sedan instead of the right-hand bus.
